pages.title: Snatch
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r V$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Melee Weapons$(br2)§lEffect: §r Attacks have a chance to disarm the target's main-hand weapon, then independently disarm one piece of armor at half that chance. Weapon chance: I=10%, II=20%, III=40%, IV=60%, V=80%.$(br2)§lConflicts: §r Looting.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r I~III from Enchanting Table, loot chests and villager trades; IV~V from loot chests only
